'''Tourist District''' was a district in the upper levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was composed of everything for tourists, such as [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]], [[Museum/Legends|museums]] or theaters.
